name: Multiple products in one message
description: Tests price lookup when the customer asks about multiple products in a single message (white melamine and MDF). The AI should return prices for both products.

messages.text: What's the price of white melamine and MDF?

expected_behaviors.description: Reply should contain at least one price with R prefix

forbidden_patterns.description: No tool call debug text in reply

notes: Tests the AI's ability to handle multi-product queries in a single message. The lookup_price tool may be called multiple times or once with multiple products. Both product names and their respective prices should appear in the response.
